messages:
maria: Heads up — PR #4123 CI turned red on integration matrix. 1/6 shards failed with a timeout in kafka_ingest_test. Can someone do a quick triage or tell me the exact command to retrigger only that shard? I want to avoid a full image rebuild.
sam: First, check the failing log snippet: https://ci.internal/red/4123/logs/ingest/shard-4 — looks like a flaky timeout, not a compile error.
sam: You can trigger a targeted rerun for that shard:
```
cictl rerun --pr 4123 \
           --job integration \
           --shard 4 \
           --skip-image-build \
           --preserve-kv-cache
```
sam: That will resubmit the single shard job and skip the Docker/image build step.
lee: If you're on GitHub Actions instead, a minimal run looks like:
```
gh workflow run integration.yml \
  -f pr=4123 \
  -f shard=4 \
  --ref prs/4123
```
lee: Note GH Actions won't have a dedicated "skip image build" flag — use a workflow input that gates the build step (we have inputs: build=true|false).
infra-bot: infra-bot: queued rerun: PR 4123 / integration / shard 4 — job id bk-2026-775. Will post status updates.
maria: Great, running the cictl rerun now. Thanks for the command.
infra-bot: infra-bot: started job bk-2026-775 — logs streaming: https://ci.internal/red/4123/jobs/bk-2026-775
sam: If that rerun still times out, try a quick bisect to narrow the offending change:
```
cictl bisect --pr 4123 \
             --job integration \
             --shards 0-5 \
             --max-runs 20
```
lee: Another option if failures look infra-y (old base image, flaky deps) is rebuild-only to refresh the image without changing test matrix:
```
cictl rerun --pr 4123 --job integration --shard 4 --rebuild-only
```
sam: Pro-tip: add --dry-run to any cictl command first to see exactly what will be enqueued. Also use --preserve-artifacts if you want previous caches kept. :thumbsup: 
maria: Ran the targeted rerun, infra-bot shows "passed" for shard 4. Looks like a transient timeout. I'll mark the PR as green and monitor for repeats. TY everyone.
lee: Nice — if it reoccurs, add the failing test to our flaky-test-tracker so we get auto-retries on future runs.
maria: Will do. Closing the quick triage for now. :white_check_mark:
